description_expanded: This beautiful home is located just steps away from the Caliza pool complex and a short walk to the ZUMA wellness facility and the emerging Town Center. Guests will enjoy three bedrooms, all with private baths and a private pool and courtyard. The first level of the home includes a half-bath, large, open family room with ample seating and dining space adjacent to the kitchen. Upstairs, guests will find the primary suite and a second bedroom, both with one king-sized bed. The third bedroom with a king-sized bed is detached from the main house across the courtyard. Parking for this home is in a one-car garage and one designated space in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
